question: What is the true nature of freedom when it is examined carefully?
premises: Freedom is nothing other than consciousness itself.
When analyzed, freedom appears in relation to many powers.
Those many powers do not alter its essential nature as consciousness.
inference: Therefore freedom is consciousness itself, even though analysis distinguishes it into many powers.
plain_english: For this reason, freedom is nothing but consciousness itself; and when examined closely, it is seen to unfold into many powers.
